{{Otheruses|Ultraviolet}}
'''Ultraviolet''' was a range of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] on the electromagnetic spectrum.

Certain beings could view in ultraviolet, such as [[Defel/Legends|Defel]], [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]], [[Gand/Legends|Gand]], [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]], [[Nediji]] and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Certain [[Droid/Legends|droids]] could be fitted with [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] that could see in ultraviolet. In poorly lit areas, guards would activate devices that could scan with ultraviolet optics. [[Glowrod/Legends|Glowrods]] allowed possessors to use ultraviolet light.

[[Ka'Dedus]] was an ultraviolet [[star]] that genetically altered the Defel to see in this wavelength.
